title: Night Cream vs Day Cream: What Is the Difference?
ex: Day cream is light and sits under sunscreen; night cream is richer and works while you sleep. Here is how to tell them apart and when you need both.
rt: Night Cream vs Day Cream: The Real Difference | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream vs day cream explained simply: texture, ingredients, sunscreen and when you need both, with an easy morning and night routine for Indian weather.
quick: Day cream is light, absorbs fast and sits under sunscreen and make-up. Night cream is usually richer and stays on for hours while you sleep, so it can hold more nourishing oils and ingredients like kojic acid. Dry and combination skin often benefit from both; oily skin can manage with one.
facts: Day cream is lighter and made to sit under sunscreen
Night cream is richer and can carry ingredients best used away from the sun
Kojic acid creams need sunscreen every morning
Oily skin often needs only a light night cream plus sunscreen
